intro: At Lunaavo, we value your privacy and recognize the importance of protecting your personal information.

Our accessibility improvement efforts are guided by the principles of WCAG 2.2 Level AA.
These principles emphasize that digital content should be:
Information and interface elements should be presented in ways users can perceive.
Navigation and interactive components should be usable through accessible input methods.
Information and website functions should be clear and predictable.
Website content should be compatible with a variety of browsers and assistive technologies.
This statement describes our accessibility goals and does not constitute a certification or guarantee that every page currently conforms to WCAG 2.2 Level AA.
